primitives.name: Score Matrix Kernel
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_{ij}': 'score differential between teams i and j (dimensionless)', 'T_i': 'team identifier (categorical)', 'D_{ij}': 'distance in time between matches (days)'}
primitives.assumptions: Scores are deterministic within fixed time intervals; teams form static clusters.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D_{ij} > 30 days, kernel decays exponentially.

layer2.mapping: Kernel maps pairwise score differentials to a symmetric matrix for spectral clustering.
layer2.telemetry: Eigenvalue spread of score matrix for team strength ranking.

primitives.name: Temporal State Transition
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'X_t': 'state vector at time t (score, team, location)', 'P(X_{t+1}|X_t)': 'transition probability matrix', 'T_{ij}': 'time lag between games i and j (days)'}
primitives.assumptions: Transitions follow first-order Markov property; external shocks are negligible.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T_{ij} < 1 day, transition probabilities collapse to identity.

layer2.mapping: State transition kernel derived from score differentials and time lags.
layer2.telemetry: Entropy of transition matrix for model complexity estimation.

primitives.name: Adjacency Graph Isomorphism
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A_{ij}': 'adjacency matrix element indicating match between teams i and j', 'G = (V, E)': 'graph of teams and matches', 'd(i,j)': 'shortest path distance in G'}
primitives.assumptions: Graph is undirected and weighted by match frequency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When d(i,j) > 5, edge weights are normalized to zero.

layer2.mapping: Graph isomorphism used to detect structural similarity in team networks.
layer2.telemetry: Graph edit distance for network alignment across seasons.
